preset_name: 竖屏静态图 10 秒快节奏硬切版 V1

motion_rules.intensity: punchy; visible motion within the first second of each shot, under 5% of frame width over a shot
motion_rules.pace_note: 2s per shot on average; motion starts immediately, no static lead-in

transition_rules.note: hard cuts only per operator feedback 2026-08-31; dissolves feel slow for fashion slideshow

text_overlay_rules.font_style: bold rounded sans, localized script only
text_overlay_rules.background: semi-transparent dark strip allowed behind text

audio_rules.embedded_bgm_policy: embedded_bgm is a degradation path only when NeoBund music attach is unavailable; requires locally licensed track
audio_rules.rhythm_preference: strong-beat tracks preferred (dance/remix/EDM pools); cut points should feel on-beat
audio_rules.master_audio: no audio stream (NeoBund attaches platform music at publish)
